in_sanskrit.name: Jiaul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jiaul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Jiaul is the name of a goddess who symbolizes wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. She is often depicted carrying a lotus in her hand and is revered by many for her blessings of abundance and success.
